messages:
Jordan: hi team, first day! quick Qs about API keys in onboarding email: I got a sandbox token but need to run a small demo from CI. Should I request a hosted key or is there a recommended way to use the sandbox for CI? Also my team needs to open firewall rules / allowlist egress  any guidance?

OnboardBot: welcome Jordan! :wave: sandbox keys are intended for interactive experiments and are short-lived. For CI demos you can use the sandbox if you refresh the token regularly, but for stable CI use a hosted key from Console  Settings  API Keys.

Nina: +1 to hosted for CI. If you need one now ping your manager or @nina and we can create a dev hosted key scoped to your repo. We usually give dev hosted keys limited quotas to avoid runaway costs.

Jordan: how limited are the quotas? worried about streaming workloads spiking.

Raj: typical dev hosted key defaults: 10	reqs/sec, 50k tokens/day. Streaming counts toward tokens as generated tokens stream out. If you hit rate limits you'll get 429s and Retry-After headers. For load-test demos ask @raj for a temporary uplift.

Jordan: thanks. ops question: does Redwood publish stable egress IPs for the hosted API? my company's firewall team needs IPs to allowlist.

OpsBot: We publish a CIDR list for gateways but it can change as infra scales. Best practice: allow by hostname api.redwood.example.com or request a static egress path from our infra team. For production-grade stability consider Redwood Dedicated or Private which can provide fixed egress IPs.

Nina: security reminder  never commit keys. Use our Vault path secret/onboarding/<username> for sandbox secrets and secret/teams/<team>/redwood for hosted keys. If you want I can help set up a GitHub Actions secret.

Jordan: that would be great, thanks. Last one: cost differences between sandbox and hosted?

Raj: sandbox uses free credits and may be throttled; model per-token pricing is the same for hosted usage. Sandbox won't appear on invoices.

Jordan: awesome, super helpful. I'll try sandbox manually and ping @nina for a hosted key for CI. Appreciate it! :smile:
